chunks: Abu al-Sabbah al-Kinani narrated from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
Whoever provides iftar to a fasting person will have a reward equal to his.

key_terms.فَطَّرَ: provided iftar; enabled someone to break the fast
key_terms.مِثْلُهُ: equal to his; like the reward of the fasting person

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for providing iftar to a fasting person in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the great reward of helping a fasting person break the fast. It encourages generosity, hospitality, and participation in the worship of others by supporting them.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1952 - Abu al-Sabbah al-Kinani narrated from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:
"Whoever provides iftar to a fasting person will have a reward equal to that of the fasting person."
